observations: A light purple or lavender PlayStation 5 console is shown in a vertical, open-back position.
One DualSense controller is placed in front of the console.
The background consists of a wall of stacked DVDs or Blu-rays.
A watermark 'HYMAN GADGETS HUB' and 'VIDEO ON JIJI' is visible across the center of the image.
The console's disc drive is visible on the left side.
The console appears to be a 'Slim' or 'Original' model based on the design.

claims.evidence: Only one controller is shown; no other accessories like cables or power supply are visible.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN) or have a 'Blue Light of Death' (BLOD) fault.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift, button failure, or battery issues.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu and a gamepad test.

risks.risk: The console may have a damaged disc drive or optical sensor.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted and the console successfully reading it.
risks.if_unproven: as having a faulty optical drive

risks.risk: The console may be a 'Digital Edition' (DE) which is significantly more valuable than a 'Physical' (PS5) edition.
risks.proof: A photo of the console's system settings showing the 'Edition' or 'Model' label.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu.
Photo of the console's system settings showing the model and edition.
Photo of the back of the console showing the model number and serial number.
Photo of all included accessories (cables, power brick, etc.).
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
